primarySourceBindings.limit: WebKit main sources explain the mechanism; they are not claimed to be the exact source revision of installed WebKit2336/26.5. Matching source text is not same-run lifecycle/ownership proof.

evidenceInterpretation: A Playwright pageerror here is not itself proof of an unhandled JavaScript exception. Collect transport provenance (native Console.messageAdded target, document and lifecycle) separately from actual JS decode rejection ownership (existing main/load/app catches and disposal). A native internal URL cannot equal a JavaScript error identity by design; no such impossible equality is required. Same-document operation/error chains and target/document chronology can support explicitly labelled same-run correlation. Native raw diagnostics remain in the unchanged strict failure record.
